What model syntax allows for the effect of age.years to be different at each level of site? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} first = glm(weight ~ age.years + site + age.years:site second = glm(weight ~ age.years + site) third = glm(weight ~ age.years * site) fourth = glm(weight ~ poly(age.years,2) + site ``` :::
### 2. Draw an x-y plot showing the relationship b/w weight and the additive effect of site and age.years. Assume a negative slope of age.years with weight and two levels of the variable site. Assume the intercept mle is 13000 and the estimated effect of siteSite2 = -2000. Label axes and slopes for each site. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glm(weight ~ age.years + site) ``` :::
### 3. Looking at the data table above, write out the design matrix for the two models below. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glm(weight ~ age.years + site) glm(weight ~ age.years * site) ``` ::: ### 4. When might it be good to assume an additive effect b/w a categorical and continuous variable over an interaction?
